author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
This Intuit Intelligence tutorial shows you how to use QuickBooks Online's built-in AI to track expenses, compare revenue, and get strategic financial advice without leaving your accounting software.
💵 Try QuickBooks Online ➜ https://quickbooks.kevinstratvert.com/

First, you'll see Intuit Intelligence in action by asking it to break down your most expensive vendors and flag the ones raising prices.

Next, you'll learn where to find Intuit Intelligence inside QuickBooks Online and how the conversational interface works across all plan tiers.

Then, you'll explore business performance questions like comparing quarterly revenue and spotting cash flow trends, with a close look at how the AI cites its sources from real QuickBooks reports.

Afterward, you'll dive into expense tracking by analyzing category changes quarter over quarter and uncovering vendor pricing patterns using standard deviations.

title: How to Use Intuit Intelligence in QuickBooks Online
